offering_description.value: Provides life insurance, annuities, residential mortgage loans, and cemetery and mortuary services to individual consumers and families, mainly in the western and southern United States. Insurance and mortgage products are sold through agents, loan officers and branches, and cemetery and funeral services are delivered at company-owned locations.

primary_products.value: life insurance; annuities; residential mortgage loans; cemetery plots and burial products; mortuary merchandise

primary_services.value: mortgage origination and servicing; cemetery services; mortuary services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual policyholders, homebuyers and families arranging funeral and cemetery services

end_markets.value: insurance; residential real estate and home lending; death care

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: life insurance and annuity premiums, and interest on mortgage loans and investments; service fees: mortgage origination fees and loan servicing, cemetery and mortuary services; product sales: cemetery property and mortuary merchandise sold at need and pre-need
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes insurance premiums and mortgage payments, and sells policies and loans to consumers; service provider: arranges burial, cremation and funeral services for families; asset operator: owns and runs cemeteries and mortuaries
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: licensed in many US states, cemeteries and mortuaries mainly in Utah, Idaho, Texas, Missouri, Arizona and other western and southern states

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: life insurance, residential mortgage lending, and cemeteries and mortuaries

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent life insurance agents selling policies; own locations: company-owned cemeteries, mortuaries and mortgage offices; direct sales: in-house mortgage loan officers serving homebuyers
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance and mortgage licenses from state regulators, state cemetery and funeral regulation

notes: Segment mix and state coverage are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
